Admission_Test: Same review task/endpoint; both people-work time measured; setup, prompt, verification, adjudication and rescue accounted; comparator design clarified
Source_Example: Chung (775 min human vs 48 min machine) / unmeasured verification
Caveat: Machine runtime is not person-minutes; comparator not a causal estimate

Admission_Test: Report all assumed per-record handling rates, PDF-preparation assumptions, and fixed costs; keep model distinct from observation
Caveat: Scenario arithmetic is not directly measured team labor

Admission_Test: Record decision count, rework count and accepted risk tradeoff; do not multiply by assumed time without labeling
Source_Example: Sanghera 2025 41.81% vs 98.32% reduction with different retention
Caveat: Smaller queue can miss relevant studies

Admission_Test: Distinguish executed from simulated review policies, count checked calls, and direct time recordings for intervention
Caveat: Simulated selection fractions are not observed person-hours

Admission_Test: Specify source of final positives, whether every rejected record was independently adjudicated, and the stage eligible for analysis
Caveat: Sensitivity on a verified subset does not identify full-corpus sensitivity

Admission_Test: Version and benchmark cohort fingerprint disjointness (review IDs, datasets, inclusion criteria, stage)
Source_Example: Janoudi preprint/journal; Cao preprint/journal; Zhang conference/journal
Caveat: New publication does not create new evidence unit

Admission_Test: Reproducible exhaustive search dates, databases, selection flow, second-person adjudication and protocol requirements
Caveat: As of R21 second independent human assessment NOT_PERFORMED and systematic search NOT_COMPLETE
